title: Look Back to Move Forward: Learning to Revisit for Agentic Compositional Image Generation
title_zh: 回顾以向前迈进：学习重访机制以实现智能体式组合图像生成

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种名为GenRevisit的智能体框架，通过学习重访机制实现组合图像生成，显著提高了视觉保真度和指令遵循能力。 Text-to-image models have made remarkable progress in visual fidelity and instruction following, yet complex compositional generation remains challenging. Existing agentic approaches address this limitation through iterative generation and editing, adapting their actions based on interaction history. However, they typically fix the continuation state (i.e., the image from which refinement proceeds) to the latest image. Since iterative editing is not necessarily monotonic, the agent may continue refining from the latest image even when it has already degraded. In this work, we introduce GenRevisit, an agentic framework that extends action selection to joint continuation-state and action selection. The agent can not only use interaction history to adjust editing instructions but also select an image candidate to edit, jointly deciding where to continue from and how to refine. We train GenRevisit with SFT followed by agentic reinforcement learning. To address the coarse credit assignment of final outcome reward in GRPO, which assigns the same trajectory-level advantage to all actions, we further propose Normalized Action Credit Assignment (NACA) to redistribute positive advantage according to each action's contribution to reducing the remaining objective. On GenEval2, GenRevisit achieves GM scores of 84.3 and 74.4 with Qwen-Image-2512 and Z-Image-Turbo, surpassing the strongest baselines using the same generators by 12.7 and 10.9 points respectively. GenRevisit achieves state-of-the-art performance on GenEval, GenEval++, and GenEval2 among baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种名为GenRevisit的智能体框架，通过学习重访机制实现组合图像生成，显著提高了视觉保真度和指令遵循能力。文本到图像模型在视觉保真度和指令遵循方面取得了显著进展，但复杂的组合生成仍然具有挑战性。 现有的智能体方法通过迭代生成和编辑来解决这一局限性，并根据交互历史调整其操作。 然而，它们通常将延续状态（即用于进一步优化的图像）固定为最新生成的图像。 由于迭代编辑并不一定是单调的，即使最新生成的图像质量已经下降，智能体仍可能继续基于该图像进行优化。 在本研究中，我们提出了GenRevisit，一个将操作选择扩展至延续状态与操作联合选择的智能体框架。 该智能体不仅能利用交互历史调整编辑指令，还能选择待编辑的候选图像，从而共同决定从何处继续生成以及如何优化。 我们通过SFT训练结合智能体强化学习来训练GenRevisit。 为了解决GRPO中最终结果奖励存在粗略的信用分配问题（即所有操作都获得相同的轨迹级优势），我们进一步提出了归一化操作信用分配（NACA）方法，根据每个操作对减少剩余目标任务的贡献重新分配正向优势。 在GenEval2上，GenRevisit使用Qwen-Image-2512和Z-Image-Turbo分别获得了84.3和74.4的GM分数，比使用相同生成器的最强基线模型分别高出12.7和10.9分。 在GenEval、GenEval++和GenEval2中，GenRevisit在基线模型中实现了当前最优的性能。
